description.zh:
向量索引算法

取值说明：
- hnswflat：不带量化压缩的 HNSW 索引（默认值）
- novam：不带量化压缩的图索引，适用于实时推荐等高性能场景
- novad：带 rabitq 量化的分区索引，适用于大规模低成本检索场景
description.en:
The vector indexing algorithm.

Valid values:

- `hnswflat`: (Default) An HNSW index that does not use quantization compression.

- `novam`: A graph-based index that does not use quantization compression. This algorithm is suitable for high-performance scenarios, such as real-time recommendations.

- `novad`: A partitioned index that uses rabitq quantization. This algorithm is suitable for large-scale, cost-effective retrieval scenarios.

description.zh:
集合名。
> 您可以[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The collection name.

> You can call the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) operation to list all collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to view the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance ID.

description.zh:
向量维度。

> - 稠密向量必传该参数。
> - 此值需和上传向量[UpsertCollectionData](~~2401493~~)接口的向量数据Rows. Vector长度一致。
description.en:
The vector dimension.

> - This parameter is required for dense vectors.
>
> - This value must match the length of the `Rows.Vector` data provided when calling the [UpsertCollectionData](~~2401493~~) operation.

description.zh:
是否使用mmap构建HNSW索引，默认为0。如果数据不需要删除，且对上传数据的速度性能有要求时，建议设置为1。

取值说明：
- 0：默认采用段页式存储构建索引，这种模式可以使用PostgreSQL中的shared_buffer做缓存，支持删除和更新等操作。
- 1：该索引会采用mmap构建索引，该模式不支持删除更新等操作。

><notice>仅6.0版本支持参数ExternalStorage。7.0版本暂不支持。></notice>
description.en:
Specifies whether to use `mmap` to build the HNSW index. The default value is 0. Set this to 1 for high-performance data uploads in scenarios where data deletion is not required.

Valid values:

- `0`: (Default) Builds the index by using segmented page storage. This mode uses the `shared_buffer` in PostgreSQL for caching and supports delete and update operations.

- `1`: Builds the index by using `mmap`. This mode does not support delete and update operations.

><notice>

The `ExternalStorage` parameter is supported only by AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0.

></notice>

description.zh:
HNSW算法构建索引时的候选集大小。取值范围：4～1000，默认值64。

> 仅AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例需要传该值，且取值需要>= 2*HNSW_M。
description.en:
The size of the candidate set for the HNSW algorithm during index construction. The value must be in the range of 4 to 1,000. The default value is 64.

> This parameter applies only to AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances, and its value must be greater than or equal to `2 * HnswM`.

description.zh:
HNSW算法中的最大邻居数。接口会根据向量维度自动设置此值，一般不需要手动设置。

> 取值范围：
>- AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 6.0版实例：1～1000。
>- AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例：2～100，默认值16。

> 建议根据向量维度来设置：
> - 小于等于384：16
> - 大于384小于等于768：32
> - 大于768小于等于1024：64
> -  大于1024：128
description.en:
The maximum number of neighbors for the Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) algorithm. The system automatically sets this value based on the vector dimension. You do not typically need to configure this parameter manually.

> Valid values:
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 1 to 1,000.
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 2 to 100. The default value is 16.

> We recommend the following values based on the vector dimension:
>
> - For dimensions of 384 or less: 16
>
> - For dimensions from 385 to 768: 32
>
> - For dimensions from 769 to 1,024: 64
>
> - For dimensions greater than 1,024: 128

description.zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账户名称。

> 您可以通过控制台->账号管理来创建账号，或者通过[CreateAccount](~~2361789~~)接口创建。
description.en:
The name of the management account that has `rds_superuser` permissions.

> You can create an account on the \*\*account management\*\* page in the console or by calling the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation.
The password of the management account.

description.zh:
向量构建索引时的方法。取值说明：
- l2：欧氏距离。
- ip：点积（内积）距离。
- cosine：余弦相似度。

> 稀疏向量只支持ip。
description.en:
The distance metric used to build the vector index. Valid values:

- `l2`: euclidean distance

- `ip`: dot product (inner product)

- `cosine`: cosine similarity

> Sparse vectors support only `ip`.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The namespace. The default value is `public`.

> You can call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to list all namespaces.

description.zh: Novad 列表数（分区数）。取值范围：[2, 1073741824]，默认值256。
description.en: The number of lists (partitions) for the Novad algorithm. The value must be in the range of 2 to 1,073,741,824. The default value is 256.

description.zh:
索引是否开启PQ（Product quantization）算法加速，数据量大于50w时建议开启。取值说明：
- 0：关闭。
- 1：开启（默认）。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Product Quantization (PQ) to accelerate indexing. Recommended for collections with over 500,000 vectors. Valid values:

- `0`: Disabled.

- `1`: Enabled. (Default)

description.zh: rabitq 压缩比特数。取值范围：[1, 8]，默认值3。
description.en: The number of bits for rabitq compression. The valid range is 1 to 8. The default value is 3.
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
向量类型。取值说明：
- Dense（默认值）：稠密向量。
- Sparse：稀疏向量。
description.en:
The vector type. Valid values:

- `Dense`: (Default) a dense vector

- `Sparse`: a sparse vector

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-vector-index --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --collection document --dimension 1024 --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --metrics cosine --namespace mynamespace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pq-enable 1 --hnsw-m 64 --hnsw-ef-construction 128 --external-storage 0 --type Dense --algorithm hnswflat --nlist 256 --rabitq-bits 3 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CreateVectorIndex --region cn-hangzhou --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --HnswEfConstruction 128 --RabitqBits 3 --HnswM 64 --Dimension 1024 --Algorithm hnswflat --Namespace mynamespace --Nlist 256 --Metrics cosine --Type Dense --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --ManagerAccount testaccount --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ExternalStorage 0 --PqEnable 1
